name: arith_sigma_odd_iff
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : Odd (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n) ↔ IsSquare n ∨ ∃ m : ℕ, n = 2 * m ^ 2
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), Odd (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n) ↔ IsSquare n ∨ ∃ m : ℕ, n = 2 * m ^ 2
informal: σ(n) is odd iff n is a square or twice a square — σ multiplicative; σ(2^a) is always odd, σ(p^a) for odd p is odd iff a is even.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → (Odd ((ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n) ↔ IsSquare n ∨ ∃ m, n = 2 * m ^ 2)
